claims.claim: Every answer in condition B was obtained by directly reading repository files, evidenced by precise source citations on each answer (e.g. 'capture-variants.mjs 66~81행', 'visual-config.mjs DEFAULTS', 'visual-check SKILL.md 0-B절').
claims.evidence: Each Q1-Q6 answer ends with a (출처: ...) line naming specific files, sections, and even line numbers. This is the signature of just-in-time filesystem retrieval, not internalized/injected knowledge. All citations were checked and are accurate.

claims.claim: The answers are not merely correct but faithful to the exact wording of the source (schema strings, :scope selector, marker filename, error>warn>ok ordering all reproduced verbatim).
claims.evidence: Q1 schema, Q3 ':scope > *:first-child', Q6 '.claude/.visual-dev-server.pid', Q4 'error > warn > ok' all match the repo files character-for-character, consistent with copy-from-file rather than paraphrase-from-memory.

claims.claim: Condition B added a genuinely-correct precision the injected phrasing may lack: Q1 prepends 'demo-app/' to the path.
claims.evidence: capture-variants.mjs runs with cwd=demo-app and writes outDir='screenshots/<target>', so the repo-relative path is indeed demo-app/screenshots/<target>/ai-notes.json. The added prefix is correct, not an error.

suggestions: The whole point of the A/B (injection vs lookup) is to compare cost/reliability, but these 6 expectations only test factual correctness — which condition B can trivially achieve by opening files. A PASS here proves the repo is readable, not that the executor internalized anything. Add a meta-expectation that scores the RETRIEVAL PATH (how many files had to be opened, whether an answer was reachable without a lookup) so the grade actually discriminates B from A.

E1 does not pin down whether the 'demo-app/' prefix is required or forbidden, so a grader must decide leniency on its own. Specify the canonical path form (repo-relative vs demo-app-relative) so PASS/FAIL is deterministic.

None of the expectations probe the two nuances that most reveal true understanding: (a) level = the LAST word of visual-judge's reply / note = the line above it (Q1), and (b) WHY the marker scheme exists — SessionEnd never port-kills, only the owned PID+descendants (Q6). Add these as sub-assertions; they separate a memorized string from a grasp of the mechanism.

Q5's expectation lists three items but the source distinguishes 'other judgments' vs 'other lens results' across two skill files. Clarify whether naming just '타 판정' suffices or both facets are required, to avoid inconsistent grading between conditions A and B.
eval_feedback.overall: The expectations are accurate and all six PASS against the real repo with verbatim-faithful evidence — but as an A/B instrument they are too easy for the lookup arm. They measure 'is the fact correct' when the experiment needs 'what did it cost to be correct and would it be right WITHOUT the file open.' Correctness is fully verified; discriminative power between conditions is the gap.
